metadata.title: Standing register of authorial flags and unexpanded steps, frozen scans 045–086
metadata.scope: Text-only support for the root editor; no image access and no frozen edits. Locations refer to pages/MPL_137_045-086_137_scanNNN.tex. Questions are distinguished from claims whose verification is merely abbreviated. Editorial unsure markup alone is not evidence of authorial doubt.
metadata.freeze: 2026-11-17 21:38:33 UTC; all 43 frozen hashes verified unchanged
metadata.context_sources: Hua locators refer to context/hua_project/137.modern.tex; PS locators refer to the supplied PS VI/VII texts; IDs refer to context/notes/RESULTS_STATE.md.
metadata.coverage_note: The register groups related flags into 30 U entries and four T entries. Routine completed calculations such as scan045's final qfd, mere formula rewritings, and illegible or wholly uncertain marginal wording are not turned into new unresolved questions. Status records what the supplied text does, not an independent proof certification.

entries.location: lines 23–24, parenthesis following the definition of Sigma-strict
entries.status: question retained; related exactness axioms added later
entries.quote: Il faut peut-être exiger qu'un composé de
entries.body: The author asks whether composites of Sigma-monomorphisms and Sigma-epimorphisms must again be of the same kind. Scan060 adds pushout/pullback requirements, but the packet does not give a consolidated proof that all required exact-category axioms follow.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Les définitions’ (lines 1278–1314), acknowledges that the initial Sigma axioms are weaker than a full exact structure.

entries.location: lines 3–8 and 18–43, theorem and marginal hypothesis question
entries.status: proof attempted on053–056; part(b) later qualified
entries.body: The universal theorem is introduced as something to prove, and the margin asks whether B should be abelian, with the wording preserved as uncertain in the frozen text. The live part(a) says fully faithful after cancelling equivalence; scans053–056 pursue the argument and restrict the exact-functor verification in U07.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’ (lines 1316–1357), gives a modern theorem and reports a narrower formalized model, without independently settling the source's general relative-Sigma claim here.

entries.location: lines 5–44, cancelled proof sketch
entries.status: cancelled; followed by the adjunction construction on053
entries.body: The cancelled ‘Indications sur dém.’ invokes the universal resolution, the filtration by spheres, and projectivity of the discs, then announces functors in the final diagram. It is evidence of a discarded proof route, not an additional surviving proof or a new unresolved theorem.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’ (lines 1348–1418), organizes the later adjunction argument and should not erase the cancelled status of this draft.

entries.location: line 23, margin beside the all-Sigma-kernels hypothesis and reconstruction
entries.status: question retained; not a demonstrated necessity
entries.quote: non, il faut condition de platitude ?
entries.body: The margin questions whether flatness is needed for the displayed reconstruction under existence of Sigma-kernels. Later proof and qualification passages do not convert this note into either a counterexample or an explicit general flatness theorem.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’ (lines 1326–1357), says flatness is unnecessary for its specified fully faithful model, whose scope must be distinguished from the entire source statement.

entries.location: lines 3–14, after the adjunction diagram
entries.status: claimed easy; no expanded verification on the page
entries.quote:
à prouver que c'est un iso --- vérification
facile.
entries.body: The proposed adjunction map is said to be an isomorphism by an easy verification. The next paragraph separately computes the counit, so that computation should not be silently treated as the omitted check of every naturality and adjunction assertion.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’ (lines 1369–1418), presents the reconstruction and adjunction as the proof mechanism.

entries.location: lines 35–43; continuation on055 and056 lines 3–26
entries.status: answered under stated hypotheses by the subsequent induction
entries.body: The author asks whether the essential image is all the relevant left-Sigma-exact functors, reducing this to the unit map being an isomorphism. Scan055 gives an induction, and scan056 distinguishes equivalence under the all-kernels hypothesis from the weaker fully faithful statement.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’ (lines 1369–1422), follows this induction and should preserve the distinction between the two conclusions.

entries.location: lines 28–33, Re NB
entries.status: claimed at least for abelian B with all exact sequences
entries.quote:
(du moins si $B$ cat. abélienne avec $\Sigma$ ttes
les suites exactes\ldots)
entries.body: Exactness of F is identified with the evaluated complex being a Sigma-resolution, but the author explicitly limits the verification to at least the abelian/all-exact-sequences case. The unrestricted relative-Sigma version should remain a separate proof obligation.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le théorème’, part(b) (lines 1344–1345), omits this qualification from its headline statement.

entries.location: lines 4–9, with the entire page's cancelled draft
entries.status: cancelled, not a live supplementary hypothesis
entries.body: The cancelled opening says it remains to prove that the displayed Hom-to-cycles map admits a Sigma-kernel. The adjoining cancelled abelian-target and functor-category diagrams should be recorded as draft work, not promoted to an additional settled universal characterization.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Caractérisation intrinsèque’ (lines 1424–1504), reorganizes the surrounding material, while this source obligation remains cancelled.

entries.location: lines 15–34, Hom calculations and parenthetical universality claim
entries.status: asserted, with no complete parenthetical proof
entries.body: The Hom groups between discs and spheres are said to be easily found, leading to full faithfulness and an essential-image description. The following parenthesis says one can see a universal property for P1 with its resolution data, without providing a separate complete argument.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Caractérisation intrinsèque’ (lines 1424–1484), supplies a modern organization but later changes the stated essential image.

entries.location: line 42, margin beside axiom d; continuation061 line 3
entries.status: marginal assertion with uncertain detailed wording
entries.quote: il suffit de demander \unsure{l'une des deux propriétés}, par ex. \unsure{d)}
entries.body: The margin says it suffices to ask for one of the two properties while pushout and pullback closure are being imposed. The detailed wording remains uncertain, so the note does not license a precise new minimal axiom theorem.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Caractérisation intrinsèque’ (lines 1424–1504), uses strengthened exactness conditions without an independently checked minimality claim here.

entries.location: lines 24–29, conclusion after axioms d and e
entries.status: provisional; essential image changed in Hua's reconstruction
entries.quote: \unsure{Je dois|Il doit} y avoir assez maintenant
entries.body: The author tentatively expects enough axioms for full faithfulness and the finite-free L,Z,B,H essential image. The uncertainty between ‘Je dois’ and ‘Il doit’ is preserved rather than resolved by context.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Caractérisation intrinsèque’ (lines 1478–1484), explicitly replaces that free-homology image by all bounded finite-free complexes, a substantive repair.

entries.location: lines 3–16 and 21–34, conditional remark and revised universal formulation
entries.kind: recognized failure of direct applicability and proposed replacement
entries.status: conditional on the preceding point; revised claim asserted
entries.body: Assuming the preceding point, the author notes that an ordinary monomorphism need not be a Sigma-monomorphism, so the previous universal discussion cannot be applied as it stands. A revised universal formulation follows, explicitly using functors Sigma-exact ‘à g’.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Caractérisation intrinsèque’ (lines 1490–1504), adds a PID hypothesis in its kernel argument and drops the left qualifier in the following modern universal statement.

entries.location: 063 line 3 through064 lines 3–7
entries.kind: relative-homological claims and explicit correction of projective generators
entries.status: comparison claims asserted; missing generator explicitly supplied
entries.body: The text invokes relative resolution comparison and uniqueness up to homotopy, says there are enough projectives and injectives, and identifies higher Ext with usual hyperext. It explicitly warns that the discs alone do not supply enough projectives and adds Psi0; the exact axioms supporting the whole relative formalism are not rechecked here.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Algèbre homologique relative’ (lines 1506–1544), treats this as the operative relative-homological setting, whose precise Q exactness remains a hypothesis check.

entries.location: line 9; derived-complex conclusion continues065 line 3
entries.status: explicitly provisional
entries.body: The proposed identification of RiF(Psi0) with derivatives of evaluation is introduced by ‘on doit pouvoir montrer’; the later identification of derivatives of Z0 with Hi is qualified by ‘sauf erreur’. The derived isomorphism RF(Psi0)≃F(C•) is then claimed from the injective resolution.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Algèbre homologique relative’ (lines 1506–1544), gives a more affirmative presentation than the source's two explicit qualifications.

entries.location: 069 line 13 through070 lines 3 and 15–22
entries.status: addressed by enlargement; extension hypotheses still need precision
entries.body: The author points out that K has no unit for the transported tensor and proposes passing to P0 or Q. The subsequent kernel and two-presentation account supplies the intended extension route, whose exactness conventions must be specified before taking it as a complete argument.
entries.context: Hua, ‘L'unité, et l'extension aux foncteurs exacts à gauche’ (lines 1634–1664), follows the same enlargement and then discusses the factorization on071.

entries.location: lines 8–15, question-marked top arrow
entries.status: uniqueness argued; existence not separately established on the page
entries.body: The monomorphism argument makes a factorization unique if it exists, while the displayed question-marked arrow still requires existence. A conditional proof using a source Sigma-kernel preserved by F and naturality is recorded in context_comparison.md; it does not require target tensor flatness under those explicit hypotheses.
entries.context: Hua, ‘L'unité, et l'extension aux foncteurs exacts à gauche’ (lines 1651–1658), diagnoses a target-kernel/flatness issue, which is sufficient in some formulations but is not shown necessary by this page.

entries.location: lines 17–23, choice/coherence assertion and unit discussion
entries.kind: unexpanded coherence checks and alternative unit formulation
entries.status: claimed immediate; unit condition described
entries.quote: Le fait qu'il soit indépendant des choix faits est immédiat
entries.body: Independence of choices and associativity/commutativity are asserted to be immediate from the restriction to K. The author then examines the unit and gives a marginal formulation avoiding existence of Ker d0, with part of that marginal wording still uncertain.
entries.context: Hua, ‘L'unité, et l'extension aux foncteurs exacts à gauche’ (lines 1634–1664), supplies the modern setting, while its strong-unit claim earlier at1587–1593 is stronger than the plain map on066.

entries.location: lines 5–20, cup-product construction and final qualification
entries.status: claimed only up to homotopy on complexes
entries.body: The product and its associative, commutative, and unital properties are explicitly given up to homotopy, with attention drawn to signs. The conclusion is a graded cohomology algebra, not an assertion of strict commutative DGA structure on the underlying complex.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le cup-produit’ (lines 1666–1691), and RESULTS_STATE's MPL_133 B06 support keeping the chain-level and cosimplicial commutativity claims distinct.

entries.location: line 3, first half of Example2
entries.status: multiplicative comparison discussed without pd structure on F
entries.quote: sans se donner la ``structure p.d'' sur $F$
entries.body: The author explicitly makes the de Rham comparison before giving F a pd structure. This records a limit of the supplied data and does not prove the existence of a general pd enhancement.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le complexe de De Rham à puissances divisées’ (lines 1693–1699), likewise acknowledges that the pd structure on F is not yet defined.

entries.location: line 3, weight-n resolution and truncation conclusion
entries.kind: asserted truncated comparison and canonical homotopy class
entries.status: claimed; truncation terminology requires precise interpretation
entries.body: The claimed comparison preserves cohomology through n inclusive and is strengthened to a specified homotopy class and canonical map. Conditional on F(Psi n)=Zn(C), a good truncation ending in cycles fits this claim, while a brutal truncation need not preserve Hn; this is a modern hypothesis check, not a source correction.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le complexe de De Rham à puissances divisées’ (lines 1700–1707), calls the target naïve truncation, a stronger identification than the supplied wording warrants.

entries.location: 076 lines 19–46 and077 lines 3–9
entries.kind: withdrawn uniqueness claim and replacement by extra structure
entries.status: explicitly corrected in the manuscript
entries.body: A live insertion negates uniqueness, beside the characteristic-p example, while the attempted proof is cancelled. Scan077 then takes the homogeneous decomposition as additional structure after discussing a possible base-change formulation.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Catégories polynomiales: axiomes’ (lines 1757–1785), explains the false lemma, but the withdrawal is already present in the frozen source.

entries.location: line 17, margin beside the degree-of-composition axiom
entries.status: omission flagged; detailed wording remains uncertain
entries.body: The margin explicitly marks an omission concerning the degree-one structure, although much of its wording is uncertain. It should not be expanded into a more precise new axiom than the frozen text supports.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Catégories polynomiales: axiomes’ (lines 1722–1785), supplies a normalized degree-one category, but that normalization is interpretation.

entries.status: resolved conditionally after stronger assumptions are imposed
entries.quote: Il faut examiner pourquoi ça devrait être $\Gamma^0(0)$.
entries.body: Scan078 places question marks on the proposed unit isomorphisms, and scan079 asks why the unit should be Gamma0(0), with another marginal question mark. Scan080 derives X⊗1≃X from the strengthened multigraded compatibility, so this is a later conditional resolution rather than an unanswered question in isolation.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Produits tensoriels et puissances divisées’ (lines 1788–1820), makes those strengthened hypotheses explicit before the unit conclusion.

entries.location: 079 lines 3–24;080 lines 3–12 and20
entries.status: added assumptions, not consequences of the initial representability alone
entries.quote: On est obligé de renforcer la propriété universelle
entries.body: The author replaces bare representability with strict tensor representation in extra variables and compatibility of the multigraded Gamma objects. Representability of homogeneous pieces is conditional, with a karoubian sufficient case and a presheaf workaround; the later strict-category equivalence uses these stronger data.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Produits tensoriels et puissances divisées’ (lines 1790–1820), supports this distinction between initial and strict representability.

entries.location: line 13, NB after the exponential formula
entries.status: suggested; induction not written out
entries.quote: pour $r=2$ d'abord, et les déduire ensuite pour $r$ quelc.
entries.body: The NB proposes stating the compatibility first for two factors and deriving the arbitrary-factor form. The preceding uncertain r-index is preserved, and no full coherence induction is supplied on the page.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Produits tensoriels et puissances divisées’ (lines 1799–1820), uses the full exponential/multigraded property rather than independently proving this minimality claim here.

entries.status: explicitly supplied in the converse data
entries.quote: Je l'avais oublié dans les axiomes préliminaires il me semble
entries.body: The author acknowledges having apparently forgotten the unit condition associated with 1→Gammaq(1). Scan082 already requires the corresponding alpha map to be an isomorphism; the final partly illegible words on083 do not justify a further invented qualification.
entries.context: Hua, ‘La réciproque’ (lines 1849–1886), includes this unit data and notes the omission.

entries.location: lines 3–6, final checks and equivalence assertion
entries.status: asserted; full verification not supplied
entries.quote: On vérifie alors les axiomes c) à g)
entries.body: The author says the remaining axioms, strict tensor properties, and Gamma compatibility check, then asserts equivalence of strict polynomial and tensor-pd categories. The mixed-degree and representation verifications are not expanded here.
entries.context: Hua, ‘La réciproque’ (lines 1893–1919), says its claimed Lean result covers only the homogeneous composition core and expressly excludes the full category axioms and representation properties.

entries.location: lines 9–10, marginal question beside the graded-module extension
entries.status: question retained; exact target not fixed by the text
entries.body: A question mark stands next to the proposed graded K-module version and the degree-ni discussion. Its exact target is not stated, so it should not be promoted to a definite objection to all module examples.
entries.context: Hua, ‘La réciproque’ and ‘Questions ouvertes’ (lines 1925–1966), discuss examples and further structure without resolving the precise scope of this marginal mark.

entries.location: 085 lines 12–14;086 line 3
entries.status: open in the abstract setting; canonical in the cited example
entries.quote: Il y a diverses questions dans le cas ``abstrait''.
entries.body: The author asks when and how Gamma*(M) carries pd structure, requiring maps Gamma p Gamma q(M)→Gamma pq(M) satisfying the pd axioms. Scan086 says the example has a canonical structure, but does not give a general solution; these maps run opposite to the alpha maps of the converse construction.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Questions ouvertes’ (lines 1940–1952), preserves this distinction between the existing alpha data and the desired pd operations.

entries.location: lines 4–10, final polynomial-law enrichment question
entries.status: general construction proposed, not completed
entries.quote: Ou aussi : quand peut-on enrichir la composition
entries.body: The author asks for composition to be polynomial in the inner argument and linear in the outer one, then reduces the intended construction to giving f↦Gammap(f) a degree-p polynomial-law structure. This is claimed for the main example but remains additional structure beyond an underlying set map in the abstract setting.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Questions ouvertes’ (lines 1953–1966), connects this to polynomial-law ideas, while PS VI §120 pp.506–507 offers a later compositional-analyzer programme rather than a proof of this construction.

entries.location: line 3, underlined heading; definition starts line 5
entries.status: heading preserved literally
entries.body: The local heading is ‘Catégories hypopolynomiales’, while the next definition says ‘catégorie polynomiale’. Neither should be silently substituted for the other or promoted without evidence to the title of all 42 scans.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Catégories polynomiales’ (lines 1717–1725), normalizes its section title; the comparison must retain the source heading separately.

entries.location: line 3, single running sentence
entries.status: characteristic-zero remark
entries.quote: Il y a donc un complexe de De Rham-Sullivan
entries.body: The frozen page contains a sentence concluding that there is a De Rham–Sullivan complex in characteristic zero, with the inserted linking phrase uncertain. It is not formatted or stated as a new title for the packet.
entries.context: Hua, ‘Le complexe de De Rham à puissances divisées’ (lines 1693–1715), treats it as the conclusion of the preceding example, and PS VI §124 p.521 later distinguishes the pd de Rham programme from other schematization approaches.

entries.location: line 3, sole transcribed marginal mark
entries.status: reading left as alternatives
entries.body: The only transcribed mark has alternatives ‘?’ and ‘2’. It does not establish an authorial page count or a definite numeral, and this text-only register does not adjudicate the image.
entries.context: Hua's page47 falls between its Dold–Puppe section and ‘Classes de suites exactes’ (lines 1228–1273), supplying no independent resolution of this mark.

entries.location: 045 lines 1–3; every fragment's scanpage/archive-foliation opening;086 lines 1–2
entries.status: 42 supplied scans; archive labels distinguished from author pagination
entries.body: The frozen filenames and scan markers cover 42 scans,045–086, whose opening comments label archive foliation44–85. Those archive labels and Hua's matching page references are not evidence of a continuous author-written pagination; no mspage marker occurs in the frozen text.
entries.context: Hua's manuscript page references are one less than this packet's scan numbers throughout the compared sections, and RESULTS_STATE's two137 records use those older page references.
